item.title: Shrinkwrap 0.24.0
item.description: Your originals, one click away: z_backups becomes z_originals with your originals at its top level. Tagging a single file now swaps it in place — a folder is a machine, one tag is a file swap. Changing a folder's tags re-renders from originals and retires the old outputs. Files you add to z_originals yourself are never touched.
